title: xmltojsonsimple action
description: Converts an XML body to JSON as org.json does: {"root": ...}, attributes and children by name, text beside them as content, repeated elements as arrays.

keepStrings.title: Keep strings
keepStrings.description: Keep all values strings; otherwise numbers, true, false and null become JSON values

removeNamespaces.title: Remove namespaces
removeNamespaces.description: Name elements and attributes without their prefix and leave out namespace declarations

removeRoot.title: Remove root
removeRoot.description: Leave out the root element: the result is its value

hasTypes.title: Has types
hasTypes.description: A type attribute (string, number, integer, double, boolean, null) sets the JSON type of an element's text

typeValueMismatch.title: Type value mismatch
typeValueMismatch.description: With hasTypes, text that does not fit its type becomes null (NULL), stays a string (ORIGINAL) or fails the conversion (ERROR); not case sensitive
